ministry: Medical, Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Rajasthan
benefits_summary: Cashless health insurance cover up to ₹25,00,000 per family per year for hospitalization, plus ₹10,00,000 accidental insurance cover across government and empaneled private hospitals.
exclusions: Non-residents of Rajasthan without a Jan Aadhaar Card
documents_required: Rajasthan Jan Aadhaar Card or Jan Aadhaar Enrollment Slip
Ration Card / NFSA / SECC / Small Farmer Proof (for free category)
application_steps: Log in with your SSO ID on sso.rajasthan.gov.in or visit the nearest e-Mitra center in Rajasthan.
Enter your Jan Aadhaar number to verify free eligibility (NFSA, small farmers, contract workers, EWS) or pay the ₹850 annual premium.
Download and print your Family Policy Document for cashless hospital treatment.
